title: ResearchReport
description: Documented evidence base from a research phase. Distinguishes confirmed findings from assumptions.

question.description: The research question or requirement being investigated

evidence.description: Where this was found — file path, URL, doc section, or test output

confidence.description: confirmed = read directly; likely = inferred from strong evidence; assumed = unverified

recommendation.description: The recommended direction based on findings, with explicit rationale

open_questions.description: Questions that remain unanswered and may affect the spec or plan

linked_requirement.description: ID of the requirement@1 this research addresses
